name: Dashboard styles
format:
<style>
/* =============================================
   Bootstrap 5.3.3 + Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3
   ============================================= */
@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css');
@import url('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css');

/* =============================================
   NEUTRALIZE MASONRY.JS LAYOUT
   -------------------------------------------------
   Node-RED dashboard v3 uses the ui-masonry AngularJS
   directive which applies Masonry.js to position
   ui-card-panel elements with absolute positioning
   (inline styles: position:absolute; left:Xpx; top:Ypx).
   These overrides force normal document flow so every
   group stacks vertically at full page width.
   ============================================= */

/* Masonry container: switch from relative (needed by
   Masonry.js absolute children) to flexbox column flow */
.masonry-container {
  position: static !important;
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  padding: 16px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* ui-card-panel: Masonry.js sets position:absolute with
   left/top inline styles. Override all of that. */
ui-card-panel {
  position: static !important;
  left: auto !important;
  top: auto !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  display: block !important;
  transform: none !important;
}

/* nr-dashboard-cardpanel: wrapper div inside each group,
   force full width */
.nr-dashboard-cardpanel {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

/* Card container: has inline ng-style with fixed width/height
   (e.g. width:642px; height:264px). Override to fluid. */
.nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* md-card (template widget): also gets inline width/height
   from Masonry.js. Override to fluid full width. */
md-card.nr-dashboard-template {
  position: static !important;
  left: auto !important;
  top: auto !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
}

/* =============================================
   ANGULAR MATERIAL NEUTRALIZATION
   -------------------------------------------------
   Strip Angular Material card chrome so Bootstrap
   is the sole visual framework.
   ============================================= */

/* Soft gray page background, no side padding */
md-content {
  background: #f0f2f5 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Top navbar: Bootstrap primary gradient */
.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0d6efd 0%, #0a58ca 100%) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(13,110,253,.25) !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme md-toolbar .nr-dashboard-toolbar-title {
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: .02em !important;
}

/* Strip Material Design card wrappers (make invisible) */
md-card {
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
}

/* Hide Angular Material group title bars */
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-groupname {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Remove padding from template + card content areas */
.nr-dashboard-template {
  padding: 0 !important;
}
md-card-content {
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Remove group borders/margins */
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group {
  border: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Style Node-RED native buttons to look like Bootstrap */
.nr-dashboard-widget button.md-button {
  border-radius: 0.5rem !important;
  text-transform: none !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  font-size: 0.95rem !important;
  padding: 8px 24px !important;
  min-height: 42px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.1) !important;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-widget button.md-button:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15) !important;
}

/* Fix Node-RED default white background on headings */
.nr-dashboard-template h1,
.nr-dashboard-template h2,
.nr-dashboard-template h3,
.nr-dashboard-template h4,
.nr-dashboard-template h5,
.nr-dashboard-template h6 {
  background: transparent !important;
}

/* Fix inner widget absolute positioning inside card containers.
   Node-RED dashboard grid engine sets inline position:absolute
   + left/top/width/height on each md-card widget inside a group.
   Override to normal flow so buttons and templates stack properly. */
.nr-dashboard-cardcontainer > md-card {
  position: static !important;
  left: auto !important;
  top: auto !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  display: block !important;
  margin-bottom: 4px !important;
}

/* Also fix the button widget wrapper sizing */
.nr-dashboard-widget {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-widget button.md-button {
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Hide certificate sections (TLS Certificate + Certificate Actions) */
#MQTT_Control_Certificate,
#MQTT_Control_Certificate_Actions {
  display: none !important;
}
</style>
